thread:
incident-bot: PAGE fired -> GPU memory throttle / OOM surge on pool a100-prod-west-2. PagerDuty PGD-9072 triggered (high). Auto-suppress: false.

pagerduty: PGD-9072 created: "GPU_MEM_THROTTLE a100-prod-west-2". Urgency: high. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> L2.

sre_oncall_devon: acked. I'm connecting to the pool now. seeing a sharp kvcache_prefetch spike and many cudaMalloc failures in the node logs.

alice: paging in here, thanks devon. can we reroute traffic to fallback pool (a100-fallback-1) while we triage?

raj: joining. quick check: `nvidia-smi dmon -s u` shows GPU0 mem at 98% on node a100-43. Kernel logs show repeated: "OutOfMemoryError: cudaMalloc failed" and oom_killer churn.

maya: customer-impact: CS reports 3 accounts with elevated 5xx rates and timeouts (acct-122, acct-78, acct-9001). Latency for those requests jumped to ~4s and error rate ~12% for last 5m. CS ticket CS-3412 created and notifications outbound.

alice: executing reroute now -> `./router set-route --from pool=a100-prod-west-2 --to pool=a100-fallback-1 --weight 1.0`

incident-bot: Router action queued: reroute job 5862.

sre_oncall_devon: initial mitigation actions:
1) pausing kv-prefetch on pool
2) draining node a100-43
3) scaling fallback pool +2 gpus

Commands I'm running:
```
# pause prefetch
./infra update-config pool=a100-prod-west-2 --kvcache_prefetch=0
# drain node
./infra drain-node a100-43 --reason "oom-surge"
# scale fallback
./infra scale-pool a100-fallback-1 --gpus 2
```

raj: I restarted the inference-worker on a100-43 but the process still fails cudaMalloc due to fragmentation. Suggest full process restart after CUDA cache flush; also lowering prefetch concurrency to 4. Applying patch now.

raj: patch applied: `--prefetch-concurrency=4`. Starting coordinated restart on a100-43 (will hold traffic).

alice: reroute completed, 95% of new traffic hitting a100-fallback-1. Observability: token-level latency for fallback is ~220ms.

maya: CS update sent: initial mitigation in place, fallback pool absorbing traffic, investigating root cause. Customers acknowledged.

sre-lead: escalate to L2 if we can't stabilize in 15m. Raj, take lead on kernel/driver side. Devon, coordinate product & CS comms. Postmortem doc: create incident/PGD-9072 entry.

sre_oncall_devon: status update: reroute active, 1 node draining (a100-43), fallback pool scaled +2 and healthy, prefetch disabled. Monitoring kvcache_evictions and cuda errors.

raj: taking over from devon. collecting /var/log/messages, dmesg, and nv-host logs. snapshotting coredumps. If fragmentation doesn't improve by restart, we'll escalate to NVIDIA support.

raj: quick note: I see many small allocations causing fragmentation (large number of small tensors from batch-size 512 requests). Rolling config to reduce default batch-size to 256 for affected route.

sre_oncall_devon: ack, noted batch-size change. Also creating a temporary canary to validate inference quality on smaller batches.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PGD-9072 updated: acknowledged by sre_oncall_devon, assigned to raj.

maya: Customer-impact summary (for ops email): 3 accounts affected, intermittent 5xx and latency spikes between 09:12-09:34 UTC, mitigation in place (reroute + scale), ETA to full recovery: 30-45m pending node drains and restarts.

sre-lead: logging action items:
- Raj: kernel/nv-driver deep-dive, escalate to vendor if persists (owner: raj)
- Devon: incident doc + CS comms (owner: devon)
- Alice: monitor routing + autoscale (owner: alice)

sre_oncall_devon: handoff: I need to rotate out in ~18m. Current state attached in thread. Leaving monitoring on, alerts to L2 if OOMs continue.

raj: I will take over after devon. I'll post updates every 10min or on notable state changes. Running final restart on a100-43 now.

alice: metrics look stabilizing on fallback. nvidia-smi on fallback nodes: mem usage 65-72% across GPUs. No new cudaMalloc fails there.

raj: restart completed on a100-43. post-restart dmesg shows fewer OOMs; memory fragmentation reduced. Continuing to watch.

sre_oncall_devon: thanks team, handoff complete.

raj: ack taking ownership. Next steps: gather logs for postmortem, confirm driver version pinned, follow up with perf team on batch-size heuristics.

incident-bot: Incident PGD-9072 status: in progress -> monitored. Last update by raj.

customer-success: will keep customers updated and close CS-3412 once we confirm stable for 30m.

sre-lead: good work. We'll convert this into postmortem template after recovery.

--- end of thread ---
